title: Normalization of a valid parity block assignment
statement: Let $n,r,g$ be nonnegative integers, and let $a$ assign a sign to each index $j$ with $0\le j<r$. Suppose that whenever $n\le gr+j$, the assigned sign $a(j)$ is $1$. Then normalizing $a$ by retaining its value at indices with $gr+j<n$ and assigning $1$ at all other indices leaves $a$ unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ assigns a sign to each index $j$ with $0\le j<r$
